message.content:
You are auditing the Boldteq marketing site at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq for visual + responsive defects vs the Webflow reference. Output ONLY a JSON array of bug records to stdout — nothing else.

Audit dimensions: D1 (visual fidelity) + D2 (responsive at 1440/1280/991/767/479 breakpoints).

For each Next.js component CSS module under src/components/ or src/app/, compare against the corresponding class in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css (33,001 lines) and the matching Webflow HTML in boldteq-v1-0.webflow/*.html.

Live site https://boldteq.com is the FINAL truth. Webflow CSS provides exact values when local diverges.

Look for:
- font-size / line-height / weight mismatches vs Webflow CSS
- color hex deviations (Webflow palette: #092245, #082753, #21cfff, #019ae6, #f5f7fa, gradients)
- padding / margin / gap that uses Tailwind defaults instead of Webflow exact values
- border-radius (10/15/20/999) wrong
- box-shadow values approximated
- container max-width drift (1280 general, 1300 portfolio)
- missing @media breakpoints (Webflow uses min-width: 1280px, 1440px AND max-width: 991px, 767px, 479px)
- grid column counts that don't match Webflow @media rules
- image heights that don't match Webflow values (e.g. portfolio cards: 280/400/450)

Output each bug as a JSON object on its own line (JSONL):
{"id":"BT-####","dimension":"D1|D2","severity":"P0|P1|P2|P3","route":"/path","component":"src/components/...","line":N,"title":"...","evidence":"webflow.css:N → X; local.module.css:N → Y","fix_hint":"...","estimated_minutes":N}

Aim for 100+ bugs across the 21 routes/pages. Severity: P1 = visible above fold, P2 = below fold or minor, P3 = micro-spacing.

Use grep + read on both Webflow CSS and local module.css files. Do NOT screenshot (no browser available). Pure code-diff audit.

Routes to cover (and their primary HTML reference):
/ → index.html
/pricing → pricing.html
/our-works → our-works.html
/our-works/[slug] → our-works-pages/*.html (9)
/how-it-works → how-it-works.html
/contact → contact.html
/beta → beta.html
/careers → careers.html
/blog → blog.html
/blog/[slug] → detail_blog-posts.html

Report only bug JSONL. No prose summary, no narration.
